acceptance_rule: leave-one-year-out error <= 50% of total and at least 9 calendar months with their own coefficient; this region: error 12.0%, 12 months

snpp_to_aqua.definition: k(m) = sum(VIIRS_SNPP) / sum(MODIS_AQUA) per calendar month; Aqua-equivalent = SNPP / k(m)

noaa20_to_snpp.definition: tested: k(m) = sum(VIIRS_NOAA20) / sum(VIIRS_SNPP) per calendar month
noaa20_to_snpp.applied: none - NOAA-20 is used 1:1 as S-NPP; see leave_one_year_out.uncalibrated for the error of doing so

as_used.definition: NOAA-20 count / k(m), k(m) fitted on Suomi NPP against Aqua (standard data), compared with the MODIS Aqua count
as_used.why: the tested conversion is Suomi NPP standard against Aqua standard; recent months use NOAA-20, near-real-time

noaa20_standard.adoption_rule: NOAA-20's own coefficients are used only if their leave-one-year-out error over all years is lower than that of the Suomi NPP coefficients on the same months

noaa20_nrt.note: too few months, all in one year, to fit or adopt anything; a single ratio fitted on the other near-real-time months is shown for comparison only

as_used.acceptance_rule: the region's conversion is accepted, and the chain as used passes the same rule: error <= 50% of total on held-out years of NOAA-20 standard data and over the complete near-real-time months, and at least 9 calendar months with their own coefficient; this region: 13.2% (standard), 26.1% (near-real-time, 3 months), 12 months

current_month.source: VIIRS_NOAA20 near-real-time, on the Aqua scale
current_month.caveat: near-real-time files have no `type` column, so static heat sources are not removed from the current month

static_source_mask.checked_on: standard rows inside the region (same rows the mask was built from)
